quirks.body: AnyAPI's Free plan grants 100K ANY Tokens/day. ANY Tokens are AnyAPI's proprietary billing unit, not raw tokens (AnyAPI: 1 ANY Token ≈ 1,000 tokens for most models, model-dependent). The 3M monthlyTokenBudget on these rows is in ANY Tokens, so AnyAPI contributes 3M ANY Tokens — not 3M raw tokens — to the published 450M+/month floor.
quirks.title: AnyAPI budgets are ANY Tokens, not raw tokens
